annotations.title: Snooze items on your Needs you list

description: Hide items from the user's own Needs you list until Monday, or sooner if one becomes more severe, as Home's Snooze does. Pass the items' keys from my_attention, or all to snooze the whole list. Never changes the findings or anyone else's list. Requires write permission and acts as the API key creator.

timeZone.description: The user's IANA time zone, such as Europe/London, when known; Monday starts in it.
